newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Sweden producer prices seen +0.3 pct Jan.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Sweden producer prices seen +0.3 pct Jan.

text.p: Swedish producer prices were expected to rise 0.3 percent in Janaury which would produce a drop of 2.1 percent in the previous 12 months, a Reuters poll of 15 analysts showed on Friday.
Forecasts varied between a rise of 0.1-0.8 percent for a range of a fall of 1.6 to 2.3 percent for the previous 12 months.
In December the producer price index rose 0.3 percent which gave a fall of 2.7 percent over the previous 12 months.
Producer prices fell 0.3 percent in January for an annual rise of 2.0 percent.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Carnegie, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, JP Morgan, Lehman Brothers, Morgan Stanley, Nordbanken, PaineWebber, S-E-Banken, Swedbank, Transferator, Unibors Markets, and Union Bank of Switzerland.
Statistics Sweden will publish January's producer price index on March 3 at 0900 GMT.
